claims.sourceText: Skeptics Society, 'Michael Shermer Named to White House UAP Science Advisory Council', 15 June 2026
claims.text: The council was announced on 15 June 2026 as formed at the request of the White House and in coordination with AARO, ODNI, the FBI and other agencies, chaired by Avi Loeb.

edges.label: Chair and member of the same 2026 advisory council
edges.note: The astronomer who built the unclassified instrumentation programme and the pathologist who published the materials analysis now sit on the same federally requested body - with neither given classified access.

edges.label: Chair, appointed June 2026
edges.note: DefenseScoop reports Loeb formed and leads the council; the Sol Foundation says it was announced by ODNI with FBI support. The two accounts differ on its legal character.

edges.label: Council announced 17 June 2026, between Releases 03 and 04
edges.note: The council was announced as formed at the request of the White House and in coordination with AARO, ODNI, the FBI and other agencies, reporting to a higher-level UAP Governance Board.

edges.label: Named as the council's molecular biologist
edges.note: The scientist who published the first peer-reviewed UAP materials analysis is seated on a body with no access to the government's own materials.

edges.label: Named for instrumentation and data collection
edges.note: The government's outside science body took its detector expertise from a self-funded civil expedition group, UAPx, rather than from a national laboratory.

edges.label: Named as the council's cultural anthropologist
edges.note: Skafish's appointment completes the Sol Foundation's placement of its executive leadership on the federal advisory body.

edges.label: Sol leadership named to the ODNI/FBI council, 22 June 2026
edges.note: Nolan, Skafish, senior adviser Tim Gallaudet, advisory board member Jacob Haqq-Misra and production lead Ross Howard were all named; the foundation called it 'a fulfillment of its founding mission'.

edges.label: Gallaudet named to the council as its oceanographer
edges.note: A retired rear admiral and former acting NOAA administrator, and a Sol Foundation senior adviser, seated on the government's outside science body.

title: Skeptic / Skeptics Society, 'Michael Shermer Named to White House UAP Science Advisory Council'

topics.title: Academic UAP science: Sol, Nolan, Santa Clara and UAPx
